name: js-ts-frontend
body: Unify the TypeScript frontend into a JS/TS frontend: accept .js, .jsx, .mjs, .cjs in addition to .ts/.tsx, so apg can scan JavaScript repos (a large class of real code) and so the frontend's own JavaScript source (src/tslib/scanner.mjs) is scanned. The TypeScript compiler already handles JS as a subset via allowJs; the work is module/extension policy, detection, classification, and a build step — not a new parser. The exactness posture is unchanged: exact where the checker resolves, UnresolvedTarget otherwise. Feature js-ts-frontend.
